## What this notebook checks

Test all declared light-source categories. Account for repeated reports from
the same participant and similarity between measurements close in time. First
test whether the categories differ overall---an omnibus test---then report the
planned comparisons in interpretable units. Check whether differences vary by
site and whether every category has enough observations.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the prepared H03 dataset in `artifacts/06_model_data/H03.rds`.
- Produces: the category definitions, overall and category-specific
  comparisons, fitted models, model checks, estimates with 95% confidence
  intervals, the exact participants, participant-days, hourly observations,
  sites, and light-source category counts used by each model, both overall and
  for every light-source category × site combination; tables, figures, and the
  exact data displayed.
- Data sensitivity: fit this identical H03 implementation to the
  manuscript-prepared dataset and compare exact samples, category × site
  counts, estimates, 95% confidence intervals, diagnostics, and conclusions.
